text: 国务院新闻办公室举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会。住房城乡建设部新闻发言人、副部长陈绍旺在发布会上表示，住建事业主要有城乡建设、住房和房地产、建筑业三大板块。三大板块都处在转型发展的关键期，概括起来是“两个转向、两个转变、三化转型”。
text_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference in its series on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan." Chen Shaowang, spokesperson and vice minister of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, said at the press conference that the housing and urban-rural development cause mainly has three major segments: urban and rural construction, housing and real estate, and the construction industry. All three major segments are in a critical period of transformational development, summarized as "two shifts, two transformations, and three transformations."
